title.narrative: Mobilization of Resources for the Implementation of Samoa's Climate Action

description.narrative: Active

Samoa submitted its second NDC in July 2021, focused on energy, waste, agriculture, forestry and other land use. Samoa has also published its Implementation Roadmap and Investment Plan, to support its NDC implementation. This project will support identifying gaps in implementation, and further developing concepts to a stage where they are investment-ready and easily supported by development partners. This work is led by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment with GGGI as the implementing partner.

The overall objective of the project is to support the Government of Samoa in preparing eight NDC-aligned project documents to advance resource mobilization and investment readiness for priority climate actions. These projects will form part of a national pipeline to attract funding from development partners, international climate funds, and private investors. The initiative aims to bridge the gap between Samoa’s NDC commitments and actionable, finance-ready projects by providing targeted technical assistance, facilitating donor engagement, and strengthening national capacity for project development and financing.
